title: Grumbach letters and ciphers, HStA Dresden Loc. 4414/04 (catalogue 564)

documents.shelfmark: HStA Dresden, 10024 Geheimer Rat, Loc. 04414/04, f. 304r (scan 0377)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the page or in the file; Ortloff does not print this letter (not yet confirmed).

transcription.source: f304r_transcription.txt, pass 2, from the archiv.sachsen.de full-size scan
transcription.notes: Plus 23 two-digit code numbers and 9 Latin-script words. Several close sign pairs (ω/ϖ, η/y, σ/6, 8/ξ) still uncertain.

documents.shelfmark: HStA Dresden, 10024 Geheimer Rat, Loc. 04414/04, ff. 307r-v (scans 0380-0381)

plaintext.source: Clear letter with about ten cipher runs; no glosses.

transcription.notes: Latin-shaped substitute letters, mostly without word breaks.

system.summary: f. 304r: substitution with word breaks in a Greek-like hand, two-digit code numbers and a few special signs, some clear words; homophones likely. The file holds about 20 keys of 1562-1566 (simple and homophonic alphabets, name signs, numbered word codes).
system.sibling_key: Key A (ff. 279r/287r/305r) and the Baumgartner-Grumbach key (f. 302r) in the same file; both tested against f. 304r and ruled out
system.notes: Ortloff vol. 4 p. 151 n. 2 lists the 21 alphabets of Bl. 279-306.

prior_solution.where: Ortloff, Geschichte der Grumbachischen Händel (1868-70), paraphrases the letters of this file and says the Gotha letters seized in 1567 were deciphered; no decipherment of f. 304r or f. 307 found yet

conditions.human_role: Project-level: posed the catalogue task (pasted solve/564 brief). No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Finding aids via DDB: GStA Rep. 39 Nr. 289 = Jan 1557, Nr. 58 = Mar-Jul 1552, neither digitised.
Ortloff 1868-70 on archive.org: the Dresden file is his Nr. 26; Bl. 279-306 = 21 cipher alphabets; letters paraphrased.
All 381 scans surveyed: ff. 1-278 clear, ff. 279-307 keys plus two cipher letters (f. 304r 1553, ff. 307r-v 1564); no decipherments.
Key A and the Baumgartner key tested against f. 304r by hand.
f. 304r transcribed (pass 1, then pass 2 with finer sign split).
One-to-one and homophonic annealing on de-1500s.
und, -en, machen, sachen, knecht, ersparen, vernemen fix e n u d m c h s k t r p.
Crib-seeded anneal: best -2.9/char, crib words and a few more, not a reading; no control run yet.

outcome.method_basis: In progress: neither key nor text of f. 304r obtained yet; a crib core of about twelve letters is consistent. ff. 307r-v not yet attacked.
